newsitem.title: USA: Man kills himself by jumping off Statute of Liberty.
newsitem.headline: Man kills himself by jumping off Statute of Liberty.

text.p: A 30-year-old man from Senegal who insisted on wanting to see the crown on the Statue of Liberty committed suicide by plunging more than 100 feet (30 metres) to his death, authorities said on Saturday.
The Senegalese man has been identified as Elhajo Malick Dieye. A National Parks Service spokesman said he was living in the New York City borough of Queens.

A National Parks Service officer said that at about 5:25 p.m. EDT (2125 GMT) Dieye approached a U.S. Park Police sergeant on the Pedestal level of the monument and stated his intention to visit the statue's crown.

"The officer advised the man that the statue was closing and directed him to an exit. The man became very agitated and then bolted to and climbed onto the concrete railing," a National Parks Service spokesman said. "The sergeant attempted to stop him from jumping but was unsuccessful, and the man fell about 100 feet landing on the Fort Wood Level of the Statue."
Dieye was taken by helicopter to University Hospital in Newark, New Jersey, here he was pronounced dead on arrival.
The 151-foot-high (46 metres) Statue of Liberty is at the entrance of New York Harbour.
